mapper.select: SELECT id, submission_id, scorer_id, score, comment, graded_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM grades WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, submission_id, scorer_id, score, comment, graded_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM grades WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO grades ( submission_id, scorer_id, score, comment, graded_at, status ) VALUES ( #{submissionId}, #{scorerId}, #{score}, #{comment}, #{gradedAt}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE grades SET score = #{score}, comment = #{comment}, graded_at = #{gradedAt}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT g.score FROM grades g JOIN submissions s ON g.submission_id = s.id WHERE s.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND g.status = 1 ORDER BY g.score ASC

SELECT #{assignmentId} AS assignmentId, COUNT(*) AS gradedCount, ROUND(AVG(g.score), 2) AS averageScore, MAX(g.score) AS maxScore, MIN(g.score) AS minScore FROM grades g JOIN submissions s ON g.submission_id = s.id WHERE s.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND g.status = 1
